design.sirenHum: Short PHRASES, not a seamless loop: each raw is one complete melodic phrase (start + end of its own); the Siren plays one phrase, then a randomised gap (audio/sfx.ts SIREN_HUM.gapS), variants alternate. Reasons: a loop would crossfade inside held notes (hum-02 ends ~1 octave below its start), would repeat mechanically, and could not re-run the vocal route / storey gate per phrase; a phrase fades out cleanly on wake.
design.sirenScream: One-shot with a short tail: the raw scream body plus its own ~60–120 ms release (the raws cut off sharply, as prompted); the room tail comes from the game reverb send. Loudest enemy vocal through the existing master compressor (no limiter bypass, no extra gain stage).
design.blightBurst: One-shot transient + decay (peak-ceiling bound: the burst is impulsive).
design.blightHiss: One-shot ~3.7 s broadband gas hiss that fades (long 0.8 s cosine fade over the raw's own decay); played once at the burst point after the burst.

loudness.method: ITU-R BS.1770-4 K-weighting, 400 ms blocks / 75 % overlap, -70 LUFS absolute + -10 LU relative gate (mono); sample peak (no true-peak oversampling)

mixCalibration.note: Per-cue momentary-max loudness at the source (derivative x CUE_GAIN, before distance / occlusion / master). Reference cues re-derived from their raws + recorded ops. Target: scream = the loudest enemy vocal, ~2.7 LU above a zombie groan and ~1.3 LU above a zombie death (brightness at 1–3 kHz adds perceived piercing quality); hum soft, ~6 LU under a groan; burst near a zombie death with a -1 dBFS transient; hiss ~ flesh-tear / hurt level.

qc.gate: tools/audio-pipeline/lib/structural.mjs cueVerdict (raw AND derivative must pass)

source.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a woman softly humming a short haunting wordless lullaby, a slow sad melody under her breath, breathy and ghostly, close mic, recorded dry with no echo or reverb, no words, no instruments, no background noise.

criteria.name: not a broadband noise wall
criteria.need: NOT (spread < 2 dB AND flatness >= 0.35 AND voiced < 0.1)

noiseFloor.note: RMS of the raw outside the trimmed span, after the applied gain. 4/6 raws (both screams, hum-02, the burst) carry the same decoder idle floor in their silent parts (harmonics of 44100/256 = 172.27 Hz, -60.8 dBFS RMS): it is trimmed away and lies under the fades / under the sound inside the span

ops.note: first frame above the start threshold (minus pre-roll) to the end of the connected active run

ops.method: ITU-R BS.1770 integrated loudness (K-weighted, gated), mono
